title: Maximum Manhattan Distance After All Moves
summary: Given a string of moves including 'U', 'D', 'L', 'R', and '_', where '_' can be replaced by any of these, determine the greatest Manhattan distance from the origin (0,0) achievable after executing all moves.
statement: Given a string of moves including 'U', 'D', 'L', 'R', and '_', where '_' can be replaced by any of these, determine the greatest Manhattan distance from the origin (0,0) achievable after executing all moves.
constraints: Execute U, D, L, and R moves from the origin.
Each underscore may independently become any one move.
Return the greatest possible final Manhattan distance.
hints: Resolve the fixed moves into vertical and horizontal displacement.
Every wildcard can extend a nonzero axis, or choose any direction at the origin.
Therefore each underscore increases the attainable maximum by exactly one.
editorial: Therefore each underscore increases the attainable maximum by exactly one.

tests.explanation: Choose both wildcards to extend away from the origin, reaching distance four.
The fixed moves cancel and the wildcard reaches distance one.
